title: No identity check before personal details

lines.t: Good morning, this is Vikram calling from Suraksha Life Insurance. Am I speaking with Mr Joseph?
Yes, speaking. Who is this again?
Vikram from Suraksha Life. You had asked for a call back about our plans on our website.
Oh yes, I did. Go ahead.
Can I ask what you are mainly saving for, and who depends on your income?
Mostly my daughter's education. She is six. My wife and my mother depend on me too.
And do you already have any life cover?
Only a small group policy through my office.
Our Health Plus family floater covers you, your wife and your daughter for ten lakh a year.
What about my mother? She has diabetes.
Your mother can be added, but pre-existing conditions like diabetes have a two year waiting period, and there is a thirty day initial waiting period for illnesses.
The premium would be about eighteen thousand five hundred rupees a year.
Would you like me to go ahead and generate the proposal in your name?
Once you receive the policy document you have a thirty day free look period. If you change your mind in that time, you can cancel and get your premium back after small deductions.
Thank you for your time. You will receive the documents by email today.
